ضِرْغَامٌ , (MA, K, and so in some copies of the S,) and ↓ ضِرْغَامَةٌ , (MA, K, and so in other copies of the S,) and ↓ ضِرْغَمٌ , (MA,) or ↓ ضَرْغَمٌ , like جَعْفَرٌ, (K, TA,) The lion: (S, MA, K:) or a lion accustomed to prey, strong, and bold. (TA.) ―
-b2- And الضِّرْغَامُ is also applied to (assumed tropical:) The constellation of the Lion. (Ham p. 110.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
